nodes.description: IBridge private _bridgeToken; the BRIDGE token staked and distributed by the contract
mapping(address => RewardPool) public rewardPools; per-token reward pool accounting (accRewardPerShare, totalStakedAmount, totalRewardAmount, lastRewardAmount, rewardToken, interestBearingToken)
mapping(address => mapping(address => StakerInfo)) public stakes; per-pool per-staker balance, stakeUpdateTime, rewardDebt, poolTokenAddress
IBuyBackAndBurn public buyBackAndBurnContract; destination for rewards of empty pools
uint256 public defaultRewardPoolWithdrawalFee; default withdrawal fee in ppm
mapping(address => uint256) public rewardPoolWithdrawalFees; per-token withdrawal fee in ppm
uint256 private constant _DIV_PRECISION = 1e18; used for reward share math
initialize(IBridge, IBuyBackAndBurn) external initializer; sets roles and initial state, approves buyBackAndBurn in bridge token
setDefaultRewardPoolWithdrawalFee(uint256) external; MANAGE_COLLECTED_FEES_ROLE gated, writes defaultRewardPoolWithdrawalFee without bounds
setRewardPoolWithdrawalFee(address,uint256) external; MANAGE_COLLECTED_FEES_ROLE gated per-pool fee setter
setMinStakeAmount(address,uint256) external; MANAGE_REWARD_POOLS_ROLE gated
setMaxStakeAmount(address,uint256) external; MANAGE_REWARD_POOLS_ROLE gated
setMaxPoolSize(address,uint256) external; MANAGE_REWARD_POOLS_ROLE gated
setBuyBackAndBurnContract(IBuyBackAndBurn) external; MANAGE_COLLECTED_FEES_ROLE gated, re-approves bridge allowance
stake(address,uint256) external whenNotPaused nonReentrant; validates limits, updates rewards, mints interest bearing token, pulls BRIDGE
unstake(address,uint256) external whenNotPaused nonReentrant; harvests, burns fee, burns interest token, returns BRIDGE

transferInterestBearingTokenHandler(address,uint256,address,address) external override whenNotPaused; hook reconciling stakes on interest token transfer, restricted to the interest bearing token contract
updateRewards(address) public whenNotPaused; recomputes accRewardPerShare from totalRewardAmount and totalStakedAmount
addRewards(IERC20,uint256) external whenNotPaused nonReentrant; creates pool if missing, pulls reward token, routes to buyBackAndBurn when pool empty
harvest(address,address) external whenNotPaused nonReentrant; public entry point delegating to _harvest
_harvest(address,address) private whenNotPaused; computes and transfers pending rewards, updates rewardDebt
pendingReward(address,address) external view returns(uint256); off-chain reward preview
msg.sender / _msgSender(); attacker-controlled caller used for roles, staker identity and token flows
block.timestamp; used as stakeUpdateTime and for reward accrual timing
_bridgeToken.safeTransferFrom(_msgSender(), address(this), amount) in stake; external token pull
_bridgeToken.safeTransfer(_msgSender(), amount - withdrFeeAmount) in unstake; external token push
IBridge(_bridgeToken).burn(withdrFeeAmount) in unstake; external call to bridge token
rewardPools[tokenAddress].rewardToken.safeTransfer(stakerAddress, rewardAmount) in _harvest; external token push of reward funds
buyBackAndBurnContract.depositERC20(token, amount) in addRewards; external call to arbitrary reward/burn contract
address tokenAddress parameter of stake()
uint256 amount parameter of stake()
address tokenAddress parameter of unstake()
uint256 amount parameter of unstake()
address stakerAddress parameter of _harvest()/harvest()
address from parameter of transferInterestBearingTokenHandler()
address to parameter of transferInterestBearingTokenHandler()
uint256 rewardAmount computed in _harvest()
uint256 accRewardPerShare computed in pendingReward()

hasRole(MANAGE_COLLECTED_FEES_ROLE, _msgSender()) gates the setter
hasRole(MANAGE_REWARD_POOLS_ROLE, _msgSender()) gates the setter
hasRole(MANAGE_REWARD_POOLS_ROLE, _msgSender()) gates the setter
hasRole(MANAGE_REWARD_POOLS_ROLE, _msgSender()) gates the setter
hasRole(MANAGE_COLLECTED_FEES_ROLE, _msgSender()) gates the setter
_msgSender() identifies the staker and is used for transferFrom and interest token mint
_msgSender() identifies the staker being unstaked and rewarded/refunded
require(_msgSender() == address(rewardPools[tokenAddress].interestBearingToken)) restricts the handler
addRewards pulls reward tokens from _msgSender()
any caller may trigger harvest for an arbitrary stakerAddress, affecting reward accrual
staker.stakeUpdateTime = block.timestamp; timestamp-dependent stake accounting
staker.stakeUpdateTime = block.timestamp; timestamp-dependent unstake accounting
stakerSender/stakerReceiver.stakeUpdateTime = block.timestamp; timestamp-dependent transfer accounting
stake pulls the staked BRIDGE amount from the user via safeTransferFrom
stake calls updateRewards before mutating staker/pool state
stake calls _harvest when the staker already has a balance
unstake harvests pending rewards before withdrawing
unstake invokes IBridge.burn on the collected withdrawal fee
unstake returns the remaining BRIDGE balance to the user
transfer handler calls updateRewards before reconciling balances
transfer handler harvests rewards for both transfer participants
handler reads and writes staker balances/rewardDebt in the stakes mapping
addRewards creates or updates the RewardPool entry
addRewards forwards funds to buyBackAndBurnContract when totalStakedAmount is zero
harvest delegates to the private _harvest implementation
_harvest calls updateRewards to refresh accRewardPerShare
_harvest performs an external reward token transfer that can re-enter before state is fully settled
updateRewards mutates rewardPools[tokenAddress].accRewardPerShare and lastRewardAmount
updateRewards scales rewards by the _DIV_PRECISION constant during multiplication/division of large values
_harvest reads rewardToken and accRewardPerShare from the reward pool
_harvest reads and updates staker.balance/rewardDebt in stakes
stake updates totalStakedAmount and computes rewardDebt = balance * accRewardPerShare / _DIV_PRECISION
stake writes balance, stakeUpdateTime and rewardDebt for the staker
unstake decrements pool.totalStakedAmount and computes the withdrawal fee amount
unstake decrements staker.balance and recomputes rewardDebt
initialize sets _bridgeToken
initialize sets buyBackAndBurnContract
initialize sets defaultRewardPoolWithdrawalFee to 300000
setBuyBackAndBurnContract overwrites buyBackAndBurnContract
setBuyBackAndBurnContract re-approves the new contract in _bridgeToken
setter writes defaultRewardPoolWithdrawalFee
setter writes rewardPoolWithdrawalFees[sourceNetworkTokenAddress]
setter validates rewardPools[token].exists before writing the fee
setMinStakeAmount writes rewardPools[tokenAddress].minStakeAmount
setMaxStakeAmount writes rewardPools[tokenAddress].maxStakeAmount
setMaxPoolSize writes rewardPools[tokenAddress].maxPoolSize
tokenAddress selects the reward pool and interest token in stake
amount participates in limit checks and balance arithmetic in stake
tokenAddress selects the reward pool in unstake
amount participates in balance checks, fee computation and subtraction in unstake
stakerAddress indexes stakes and receives the reward transfer in _harvest
from is the sender whose stake balance and rewardDebt are debited
to is the receiver whose stake balance and rewardDebt are credited
rewardAmount is derived via accumulated - staker.rewardDebt inside _harvest
accRewardPerShare is computed from totalRewardAmount minus lastRewardAmount scaled by _DIV_PRECISION
pendingReward reads a memory copy of the RewardPool
pendingReward reads the StakerInfo of the requested staker
